summary: Renders a sprite footprint into an 8x8 proximity grid. Converts a world position (a3[0], a3[2]) with radius a4 into clamped grid cell ranges using grid origin (this+0x924 / this+0x92C) and grid scale (this+0x928 / this+0x930) via CRTFtol, then calls SphereProximityTag for every cell of the covered rectangle, tagging each cell with the tag-cursor field this+0x934. If any index clamped (grid overflow) it also tags an extra cell at this+0x900. Finally it bumps the tag cursor and returns it.

operations.description: Compute the minimum grid column: CRTFtol((a3[0] - a4 - grid_origin_x(this+0x924)) * grid_scale_x(this+0x928)), clamped into 0..7; clamping raises an out-of-range flag.
Compute the maximum grid column: CRTFtol((a3[0] + a4 - grid_origin_x(this+0x924)) * grid_scale_x(this+0x928)), clamped into 0..7.
Compute the minimum grid row: CRTFtol((a3[2] - a4 - grid_origin_y(this+0x92C)) * grid_scale_y(this+0x930)), clamped into 0..7.
Compute the maximum grid row: CRTFtol((a3[2] + a4 - grid_origin_y(this+0x92C)) * grid_scale_y(this+0x930)), clamped into 0..7.
Proceed with the grid iteration only when the column range is non-empty (minimum column <= maximum column).
Outer loop over grid rows from the minimum to the maximum; each step advances the cell pointer by 72 dwords, one full row of eight 36-byte cells.
Inner guard: iterate over cells only while the current column is within the computed row-range of columns.
Inner loop over the covered columns, stepping 9 dwords (one 36-byte cell) per iteration and calling SphereProximityTag for each cell.
SphereProximityTag(cell, tag_cursor, a2, a3, a4) tags the grid cell with the current value of the tag-cursor field this+0x934 plus caller context a2, position a3 and radius a4.
If any computed index was clamped (grid range overflow), tag the extra cell at this+0x900 with the current tag cursor.
Increment the tag-cursor field this+0x934 by one and hold the new value as the return value.
Return the updated tag cursor (previous value plus one).
